actual_hs_list: 846620 (tool holders / work holders for machine tools - collets, guide bushes, bar feeder collets, ER spindles, collet chucks)
846610 (tool holders / self-opening dieheads - partially applicable to ER spindles and collet chucks)
820790 (interchangeable tools for hand/machine tools - honing mandrels, sleeves, jigs & fixtures, if sold as tooling)
732690 / 732619 (steel sleeves and bushes as articles of iron/steel, if not classified as machine-tool work holders)
product_summary: Precision tooling / work-holding for Swiss-type CNC automatic lathes: collets (incl. bar feeder collets), carbide-lined guide bushes, collet chucks, ER spindles/collet shanks, honing mandrels, sleeves, holding tools, jigs and fixtures, plus customised solutions and white-label production. Materials: special-grade steels and carbide. Founded 2002, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu; ISO 9001:2015; 150+ employees; 35,000+ sqft. Serves automobile, defence, textile, aerospace/space, medical, electronics, watch components, miniature bearings, jewellery. Source: https://www.tecnicrafts.com/ and https://www.tecnicrafts.com/about-us/ (product menu: Collets, Carbide Lined Guide Bushes, Bar Feeder Collets, ER Spindles, Customised Solutions).
comment: HS 846620 is the correct primary heading: the company's core output is work holders (collets, guide bushes, collet chucks) for machine tools - exact match on the main line. HS 846610 (tool holders) is only partially applicable: ER spindles/collet shanks and collet chucks can fall under 846610, but the bulk of the range (collets, guide bushes, bar feeder collets) is 846620. Declared pair is therefore 'partial' - not wrong, but the split between the two headings is not corroborated. Product lines missing from the declaration: honing mandrels, sleeves, jigs & fixtures, holding tools (likely 8207/7326 depending on presentation) and customised/white-label solutions. Industry classification 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a precision machine-tool tooling / work-holding manufacturer (engineering, HS ch. 84/82), not a metallurgy or mining supplier - it consumes steel and carbide but does not produce metals or mining equipment. No trader signs found: own plant, own CNC and conventional machines, in-house processes, ISO 9001:2015, 2 MW captive solar plant in Madurai - consistent with a genuine manufacturer. All product claims are from the company's own website/catalogue only; no customs line was available in this task, so the actual export HS codes and the 846610/846620 split are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rules the HS discrepancy is not a rejection ground - company retained, code corrected to 846620 as primary with 846610 secondary.
